title: Orecchiette with Sausage and Broccoli Rabe
description: The Italian-American weeknight classic done right: ear-shaped pasta that catches crumbles of browned sausage and bitter broccoli rabe, bound together by starchy pasta water and sharp Pecorino. Blanching the greens in the pasta water saves a pot and tames the bitterness.

ingredients.name: broccoli rabe
ingredients.notes: about 1 lb, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces

steps.text: Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Blanch the broccoli rabe for 2 minutes, then scoop it out with a spider or slotted spoon — keep the water boiling. Run the broccoli rabe under cold water to stop cooking, then roughly chop.
Cook orecchiette in the same blanching water until just al dente. Reserve ½ cup pasta water before draining.

While the pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sausage in small crumbles and cook, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until browned and cooked through with some crispy edges, 5 to 7 minutes.

Reduce heat to medium. Add garlic and red pepper flakes and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add the blanched broccoli rabe and toss to combine, cooking for another 2 minutes until heated through.

Add drained orecchiette and ¼ cup pasta water to the skillet. Toss everything together over medium heat, adding more pasta water as needed to loosen. Remove from heat, stir in Pecorino, and finish with a drizzle of olive oil.

inspirations.author: Mark Bittman
inspirations.note: A staple of Italian-American home cooking, widely published across both NYT and BA with minor variations
